phoneNumbers.title: Phone numbers
phoneNumbers.description: One number per line. International format with + works for any country. Numbers without + are interpreted using the default country below.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: 2 letter country code (US, GB, KE, IN...) used for numbers written without the + prefix, e.g. 0722123456. Leave empty if all your numbers start with +.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many numbers checked.
